currentParagraphText: “So, I’ll need a really good explanation,” Jake said, not much friendliness in his voice.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “So, I’ll need a really good explanation,” Jake said, not much friendliness in his voice.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “And I’ll give one,” the Augur nodded with a sigh. “Nothing that happened here played out the way I would have preferred it to, and I can’t even say the outcome was unpredictable.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Flying over, he landed not far from the two of them, and Bertram didn’t even try to stand in front or be defensive. Not that he needed to, as Jake had no thoughts of attacking, at least not if he wasn’t forced into it.
